thread:
sara: Helios lab confirmed Thursday 2026-06-12 14:00-18:00 PST for the GPU perf/W sweep. Need final test matrix, telemetry schema, and who owns kernel patches during the run. cc @noah_helios @dmitri
noah_helios: thanks! we'll bring 2x Helios accelerators and a dev swapper. want us to run default scheduler + our kernel patches in two passes? :thinking: 
dmitri: yes two passes. baseline with stock kernel + default kernels, then with Helios tuned kernels. key dims: seq lengths [128,512,2048], batch sizes [1,4,16], quant modes [fp16,int8]. capture: power (sampled 10Hz), p50/p95/p99 lat, tokens/s, GPU mem, temp. i'll attach a quick matrix in thread.
sara: perfect. tara will own telemetry handoff to console ingestion — @tara can you confirm retention/format?
tara: can confirm. we need CSV + NDJSON for events. fields: run_id, model, kernel_tag, seq_len, batch, quant, throughput_tps, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, watt_mean, watt_peak, gpu_temp_c, kv_cache_hit_rate, notes. retention 90d in staging, 365d for partner deliverables.
dmitri: here's the short matrix (paste):
```
model,gpu,seq,batch,quant,pass
redwood/pegasus-small,Helios-H100,128,1,fp16,baseline
redwood/pegasus-small,Helios-H100,512,4,int8,baseline
redwood/pegasus-small,Helios-H100,2048,16,int8,tuned
redwood/pegasus-medium,Helios-H100,512,4,fp16,baseline
```
noah_helios: good. for kernel_tag we'll use helios-v1.2 for tuned. we'll also run a "latency-only" micro-benchmark for single-token chattiness. any ops we should avoid?
sara: avoid long eval prompts that thrash KV cache on first pass — we want steady-state throughput.
dmitri: for telemetry — use timestamp ISO8601, sample_id per 1s. send a test payload to preflight endpoint: https://console.redwood.dev/telemetry/preflight
infra-bot: reservation created helios-lab-3; owner=noah_helios; window=2026-06-12T14:00:00-08:00/2026-06-12T18:00:00-08:00
tara: I'll drop the NDJSON schema into the shared folder and ping legal for the partner NDA clause about telemetry. :white_check_mark:
sara: who will run the kernel flip? @dmitri or @noah_helios?
dmitri: we'll do first pass, Helios team will apply tuned kernel image between runs. need ~30min for warmup and verification.
noah_helios: confirmed. we'll also bring our power-meter for cross-verify. can you allocate a spare loadgen VM for driver logs? @lee
lee: allocated: loadgen-us-west-2-8 (ssh keys on lastpass). I'll also enable sysstat and nvidia-smi logging.
sara: checklist for Thurs: matrix (done), telemetry schema (tara), lab reservation (infra-bot), kernel images (noah_helios), run owner schedule (dmitri -> 14:00-16:30, noah_helios -> 16:30-18:00), post-run CSV + NDJSON drop (tara). any blockers?
dmitri: only blocker is the quant toolchain for int8 on our CI — i'm prepping a container, should be ready by Mon.
noah_helios: we'll provide kernel build artifacts by Tue EOD.
tara: I'll send calendar invites + shared folder today. also drafting the joint one-pager for partner announcement that calls out perf/W improvements (tentative numbers not to be published without approval).
sara: awesome. :tada: pulling in legal & comms after results. if anything changes ping #partnerships.
